purpose: Absolute front-surface targets for the PARRY DOLL heroine, informed by the five-view modeling sheet and CC0 MakeHuman/MPFB continuous facial topology.
coordinate_system: heroine logical coordinates: y up, z forward, x left/right

surface_blend.description: Use 1/(1+(abs(x)/half_width)^power) to spread depth through neighboring facial vertices rather than a narrow center-line spike.

acceptance_notes: The nose tip must remain visible in true profile without becoming a bulb in three-quarter view.
Upper and lower lip volumes must sit in front of the labiomental crease while remaining part of the same surface.
The chin must project enough to break the spherical egg silhouette but remain behind the lips.
The entire almond sclera aperture must be readable from the front; the iris must not appear as a target ring.
